backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the RevReel backend, defining all core data types (UserProfile, Video, Comment, CarMeet, etc.) and including authorization and blob-storage mixins for a car-culture social platform.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two upload-related feature requirements (upload FAB/button and upload page file handling) to their implementing frontend files and component dependencies.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their roles in the RevReel app's UI, hooks, routing, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the RevReel Vite/React app, mounting the React root and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router configuration with all app routes (feed, profile, upload, builds, classifieds, etc.) nested under a shared Layout component, wrapped in a React Query provider.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Component that gates content behind Internet Identity authentication, showing a loading spinner, a styled login prompt, or the wrapped children depending on auth state.
frontend/src/components/CarMeetCard.tsx: Card component for displaying a car meet's title, category, location, date, and attendee count, with attend/leave toggle buttons for authenticated users and a link to the meet details page.
frontend/src/components/ChallengeModal.t: A modal dialog that lets the current user select one of their uploaded videos to send as a challenge to another user, using the postChallenge mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/CommentsPanel.ts: A slide-in panel that displays sorted comments for a given video and allows authenticated users to post new comments via a form.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileModal: A modal form for editing the current user's profile, supporting username, bio, and avatar image upload with preview before submitting via the updateProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/FollowButton.tsx: A small button component that toggles following/unfollowing a user, hiding itself when the viewer is the same user or unauthenticated.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The root application layout providing a fixed header with logo/upload/auth controls, a bottom navigation bar with primary and secondary nav items, and a profile setup modal trigger for new users.
frontend/src/components/PostIssueModal.t: A modal form for posting a car-related mechanical issue with a title, category selector, and description, submitting via the createMechanicsPost mutation and showing toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/PostListingModal: A modal dialog component for creating a new parts/car listing, with form fields for title, make, model, year, price, condition, category, image URL, and description, using the useCreateListing mutation on submit.
frontend/src/components/PostMeetModal.ts: A modal dialog for organizing a car meetup, collecting title, location, datetime, category, and description, then submitting via useCreateCarMeet with the date converted to nanoseconds.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A full-screen modal for first-time profile creation, allowing username, bio, and avatar upload, with a pre-check to skip creation if a profile already exists, using useSaveCallerUserProfile.
frontend/src/components/StartBuildLogMod: A modal dialog for starting a new car build log, collecting title, make, model, year, and description, then submitting via the useCreateBuildLog mutation.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A full-bleed video/photo card component supporting likes, emoji reactions, save/unsave, delete, view count increment, comments panel, and challenge modal, with media rendered as either a video or image based on mediaType.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, and invalidates all dependent queries whenever the actor instance changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines all React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for the app's backend interactions, along with shared TypeScript interfaces for entities like Video, UserProfile, CarMeet, and an ExternalBlob utility class for handling binary media.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Barlow fonts, configures Tailwind CSS, defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, and adds utility classes for neon effects and glassmorphism.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: Static About page describing RevReel's features and mission, with a hero section, feature list, and a copyable Cash App donation tag.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin-only page that lists all users and allows deletion, gating access via an admin check and wrapping the UI in an AuthGuard component.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogDetails.tsx: Displays a single build log's details including car info, description, and build stages. Allows the owner to add new stages or delete the log.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogs.tsx: Lists all build logs as cards with car info, stage count, and date. Authenticated users can create a new build log via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeetDetails.tsx: Shows detailed information for a single car meet including date, location, attendees, and category. Authenticated users can join or leave the meet.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeets.tsx: Displays a filterable list of car meets with attend/leave functionality. Authenticated users can post new meets via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/Classifieds.tsx: Shows a grid of active vehicle/parts listings with image, price, and condition. Authenticated users can post new listings via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/Conversation.tsx: Renders a direct message thread between the current user and another user, with send and delete message functionality and auto-scroll to the latest message.
frontend/src/pages/Discover.tsx: Displays a discovery page with video categories and trending hashtags derived from all videos, allowing navigation to filtered feeds by clicking a category or tag.
frontend/src/pages/Feed.tsx: Renders a full-screen, snap-scrolling vertical feed of all videos sorted by newest first, wrapped in an AuthGuard.
frontend/src/pages/FilteredFeed.tsx: Shows a filtered list of videos by category or hashtag based on URL params, with a back-navigation header and video count.
frontend/src/pages/Inbox.tsx: Displays a list of direct message conversations with unread counts and last message previews, linking to individual message threads.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page with hero section, feature highlights, and Internet Identity login; redirects authenticated users to the feed.
frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.tsx: Shows a leaderboard with trending videos and top racers ranked by total likes, displayed in a two-column grid with a banner image.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetails.tsx: Renders the detail view for a marketplace listing including image, price, vehicle info, seller profile, and a remove option for the listing owner.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicsHelp.tsx: Displays a paginated, filterable list of mechanics help posts with category tabs and a modal to create new posts. Authenticated users can post issues; all users can browse and click through to post details.
Shows the full detail view of a single mechanics help post including its description, comments, and a comment input field. Post authors can delete the post; authenticated users can add comments.
frontend/src/pages/Notifications.tsx: Renders a list of user notifications with read/unread states and relative timestamps. Supports marking individual or all notifications as read, and navigates to the sender's profile on click.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Displays a user's profile page including stats, badges, uploaded videos, and saved videos across tabs. Supports own-profile editing, video deletion, and follow actions for other users.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: Provides a form for uploading videos or photos with title, description, category, hashtags, and optional thumbnail. Handles chunked upload progress via ExternalBlob and navigates to the feed on success.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist values in sessionStorage and clean sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, custom fonts (Barlow), OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, neon box shadows, and animation keyframes for the RevReel frontend.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for RevReel, a social media app; records two existing fix-request features focused on adding a visible upload button and repairing the chunked file upload flow for reels and images.
